configuration.cache_condition: Warm-cache workflow: checksum and original component validation read inputs before each timed interval. Fresh process does not mean cold filesystem cache.
configuration.timing: Frozen Step 1 primary interval includes reads, graph construction, computation, all four exports, closure and promotion. Cluster startup/teardown and original validation are recorded separately. No forced physical-media fsync.
configuration.monitoring: External total-process-tree RSS at 100 ms. Dask managed/spill observations at 250 ms; buffered in worker memory and collected after primary timing. Instrumentation overhead is included in observed timings.
configuration.order: One warm-up per method. Four balanced-position measured rounds, then one predeclared fifth round. No runtime-based exclusions.
configuration.storage: Original inputs and new output rasters on C: SATA SSD; frozen mask on D: SATA HDD. Same frozen mask bytes for both methods, resident for original validation; Dask also reads it lazily during primary computation.

hardware.source: Read-only Windows CIM, Get-Volume, Get-PhysicalDisk and Get-Partition queries during Step 2A preparation
